narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our journey into the world of trigonometry! In this lesson, we'll explore the fundamental concepts that form the basis of this essential branch of mathematics. We'll start by understanding what trigonometric ratios are and how they relate to the sides and angles of a right-angled triangle. Get ready to unlock the power of these relationships!
